## Description

Separate switches: record my consultations (asked again each visit), reminders on WhatsApp (no medical details), share records with ABHA/HIE, caregiver access, health tips & offers; each change creates a consent receipt; footer "Policy v… · {country law} · last change {time}". Withdrawal of recording consent offers audio deletion request (P5-12/H-10).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Each toggle creates a new receipt; history is visible to the patient.
- [ ] **AC2.** Turning off WhatsApp reminders stops future WhatsApp messages immediately.
- [ ] **AC3.** Withdrawing recording preference is reflected at the next visit's consent step (still asked per visit).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
